package catalog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

const (
	testTrackID = "9cdd012b-44ce-4f26-872e-1a0c214e2316"
	testLevelID = "b0502515-792e-4dc0-99be-590e70fa4722"
)

type testTrackRepo struct {
	created *domain.Track
	items   map[string]domain.Track
}

func (r *testTrackRepo) Create(_ context.Context, item domain.Track) error {
	r.created = &item
	if r.items == nil {
		r.items = map[string]domain.Track{}
	}
	r.items[item.ID] = item
	return nil
}
func (r *testTrackRepo) Get(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.Track, error) {
	item, ok := r.items[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &item, nil
}
func (r *testTrackRepo) GetBySourceKey(_ context.Context, sourceKey string) (*domain.Track, error) {
	for _, item := range r.items {
		if item.SourceKey == sourceKey {
			return &item, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *testTrackRepo) Update(_ context.Context, item domain.Track) error {
	r.items[item.ID] = item
	return nil
}
func (r *testTrackRepo) Delete(context.Context, string) error { return nil }
func (r *testTrackRepo) List(context.Context, filters.TrackFilters) ([]domain.Track, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

type testTrackI18nRepo struct {
	entries []domain.TrackI18n
}

func (r *testTrackI18nRepo) Upsert(_ context.Context, item domain.TrackI18n) error {
	r.entries = append(r.entries, item)
	return nil
}
func (r *testTrackI18nRepo) ListByTrack(_ context.Context, trackID string) ([]domain.TrackI18n, error) {
	result := make([]domain.TrackI18n, 0)
	for _, item := range r.entries {
		if item.TrackID == trackID {
			result = append(result, item)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}
func (r *testTrackI18nRepo) Delete(context.Context, string, int) error { return nil }

type testI18nRepo struct {
	items map[int]domain.I18n
}

func (r testI18nRepo) Create(context.Context, domain.I18n) error { return nil }
func (r testI18nRepo) GetByID(_ context.Context, id int) (*domain.I18n, error) {
	item, ok := r.items[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &item, nil
}
func (r testI18nRepo) GetByLanguage(_ context.Context, language string) (*domain.I18n, error) {
	for _, item := range r.items {
		if item.Language == language {
			return &item, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r testI18nRepo) List(context.Context) ([]domain.I18n, error) { return nil, nil }

func TestCreateTrackUsesStableIdentityAndRequiresRUEN(t *testing.T) {
	i18n := testI18nRepo{items: map[int]domain.I18n{
		1: {ID: 1, Language: "ru"},
		2: {ID: 2, Language: "en"},
	}}

	t.Run("preserves importer identity", func(t *testing.T) {
		tracks := &testTrackRepo{}
		translations := &testTrackI18nRepo{}
		uc := CreateTrack{Tracks: tracks, TrackI18n: translations, I18n: i18n}
		order := 8

		item, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), CreateTrackInput{
			ID:        testTrackID,
			Slug:      "backend",
			SourceKey: "catalog.track.backend",
			Order:     &order,
			Translations: []domain.TrackI18n{
				{I18nID: 1, Title: "Бэкенд", Description: "Описание"},
				{I18nID: 2, Title: "Backend", Description: "Description"},
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("create track: %v", err)
		}
		if item.ID != testTrackID || item.SourceKey != "catalog.track.backend" || item.Order == nil || *item.Order != order {
			t.Fatalf("identity/order = (%q, %q, %v), want (%q, %q, %d)", item.ID, item.SourceKey, item.Order, testTrackID, "catalog.track.backend", order)
		}
		if tracks.created == nil || len(translations.entries) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("repository writes = track:%v translations:%d", tracks.created != nil, len(translations.entries))
		}
	})

	t.Run("rejects active entity without English translation", func(t *testing.T) {
		tracks := &testTrackRepo{}
		uc := CreateTrack{Tracks: tracks, TrackI18n: &testTrackI18nRepo{}, I18n: i18n}
		_, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), CreateTrackInput{
			ID:           testTrackID,
			Slug:         "backend",
			Translations: []domain.TrackI18n{{I18nID: 1, Title: "Бэкенд", Description: "Описание"}},
		})
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("error = %v, want validation error", err)
		}
		if tracks.created != nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid track was persisted")
		}
	})

	t.Run("rejects out of range global order", func(t *testing.T) {
		tracks := &testTrackRepo{}
		uc := CreateTrack{Tracks: tracks, TrackI18n: &testTrackI18nRepo{}, I18n: i18n}
		order := 32768
		_, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), CreateTrackInput{
			ID:     testTrackID,
			Slug:   "backend",
			Order:  &order,
			Status: nil,
			Translations: []domain.TrackI18n{
				{I18nID: 1, Title: "Бэкенд", Description: "Описание"},
				{I18nID: 2, Title: "Backend", Description: "Description"},
			},
		})
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("error = %v, want validation error", err)
		}
		if tracks.created != nil {
			t.Fatal("track with invalid order was persisted")
		}
	})
}

type testLevelRepo struct {
	items map[string]domain.CourseLevel
}

func (r testLevelRepo) Create(context.Context, domain.CourseLevel) error { return nil }
func (r testLevelRepo) Get(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.CourseLevel, error) {
	item, ok := r.items[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &item, nil
}
func (r testLevelRepo) GetBySourceKey(context.Context, string) (*domain.CourseLevel, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r testLevelRepo) Update(context.Context, domain.CourseLevel) error { return nil }
func (r testLevelRepo) Delete(context.Context, string) error             { return nil }
func (r testLevelRepo) List(context.Context, filters.CourseLevelFilters) ([]domain.CourseLevel, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

type testTrackLevelRepo struct {
	trackID string
	items   []domain.CatalogRelationOrder
}

func (r *testTrackLevelRepo) Add(context.Context, string, string, int) error { return nil }
func (r *testTrackLevelRepo) Delete(context.Context, string, string) error   { return nil }
func (r *testTrackLevelRepo) Replace(_ context.Context, trackID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	r.trackID = trackID
	r.items = append([]domain.CatalogRelationOrder(nil), items...)
	return nil
}

type testTxManager struct {
	calls int
}

func (tx *testTxManager) WithTx(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context) error) error {
	tx.calls++
	return fn(ctx)
}

func TestReplaceTrackLevelsIsValidatedAndTransactional(t *testing.T) {
	tracks := &testTrackRepo{items: map[string]domain.Track{testTrackID: {ID: testTrackID}}}
	levels := testLevelRepo{items: map[string]domain.CourseLevel{testLevelID: {ID: testLevelID}}}
	relations := &testTrackLevelRepo{}
	tx := &testTxManager{}
	uc := ReplaceTrackLevels{Tracks: tracks, Levels: levels, TrackLevels: relations, Tx: tx}

	err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), testTrackID, []domain.CatalogRelationOrder{{ChildID: testLevelID, Order: 0}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replace levels: %v", err)
	}
	if tx.calls != 1 || relations.trackID != testTrackID || len(relations.items) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("transaction calls=%d track=%q items=%d", tx.calls, relations.trackID, len(relations.items))
	}

	err = uc.Handle(context.Background(), testTrackID, []domain.CatalogRelationOrder{
		{ChildID: testLevelID, Order: 0},
		{ChildID: "dc1df284-b812-4d11-aed7-9a604f7764cf", Order: 0},
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate order error = %v, want validation error", err)
	}
	if tx.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid replacement started a transaction; calls=%d", tx.calls)
	}
}
